title: Cantor Hall, Quantum OS 2000 Professional, & The Chickenshit Report
description: Moving into Cantor Hall with Level 3 sign-out privileges, Katie and Nate start the Web Applications Developer course—where the old administrator and their teacher let everyone use personal laptops because VITA's locked-down Quantum OS 2000 Professional desktops are horribly outdated, a clueless new administrator parrots VITA rules, they bond with middle-aged classmates Tina, Jim, and Sheila, and a violent afternoon in the therapeutic pool lands Nate on the morning 'Chickenshit Report.'
